title: Nightcord at 25:00 Chapter1 Episode4 OWN

rows.Speaker: [Amia]
rows.Line: <Yawn... I don't think I've got any more in me today. I'm gonna log off.>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line:
<In that case, I'll also...
Oh, that reminds me. I had something I wanted to ask you guys.>

rows.Speaker: [Amia]
rows.Line:
<Yeah! I've heard of them!
A lot of people are talking about 'em right now!>

rows.Speaker: [Amia]
rows.Line: <It's another creator who makes music like us! They showed up out of the blue about two weeks ago. Every song they've posted has gotten over 200,000 views.>

rows.Speaker: [Yuki]
rows.Line: <Over 200,000? That's impressive for someone who just started.>

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line: <Never heard of them. How did they get so popular?>

rows.Speaker: [Amia]
rows.Line: <I'm not surprised. I didn't know about them either until yesterday. One of my die-hard music buddies told me about them.>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line: <I'll send you the URL so you can check 'em out. I'm sure you two will be surprised. Their songs are kinda overwhelming.>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line: <Yeah. It's hard to describe, but it felt like the first time I heard one of K's songs. Like they've taken something that's too hard to put into words and given it form.>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line: <Unlike K's songs, though, OWN's are really cold.>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line: <I don't know if I'm explaining it very well, but even though your songs give off a dark, sad feeling, they also have a sense of warmth to them.>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line: <OWN's don't have that at all. They're cold all the way through. It feels like they're rejecting anything and everything.>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line: <But that's what gives them their appeal. To be honest, it's a little scary, but I really like them.>

rows.Speaker: [Amia]
rows.Line: <I totally get it. They have that kind of sharp tone that feels like it's cutting into your soul. I wonder what kind of person you have to be to make songs like that.>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line: <No idea. I'm curious, but I also don't think I want to know.>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line: <If only my drawings could be that amazing, too...>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line: <Oh, sorry. It's nothing. Forget I said anything.>

rows.Speaker: [Yuki]
rows.Line: <I think your artwork is plenty amazing, Enanan.>

rows.Speaker: [Yuki]
rows.Line: <You always manage to capture the feel of K's songs perfectly. I was really surprised at how good your last illustration was.>

rows.Speaker: [Yuki]
rows.Line:
<It felt delicate and gentle, but also a little sad.
I thought it was wonderful.>

rows.Speaker: [Amia]
rows.Line: <I'm starting to pass out here. Time to get some sleep.>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line: <I should get to sleep, too. Talk to you tomorrow.>

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line: <Here they are. Looks like they've already got four songs.>

rows.Speaker: [Yuki]
rows.Line: <Yeah. I wonder what they're like. Why don't we give them a listen?>

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line: (It's like I can hear them screaming...)

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line: (It feels like they're all alone, drowning in a sea of despair.)

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line: (But this sound... This feeling... I feel like I've heard it before...)

rows.Speaker: [Yuki]
rows.Line: <Just listening to the one song is kind of exhausting. I think I get what Enanan meant by it being overwhelming.>

rows.Speaker: [Yuki]
rows.Line: <What do you want to do, K? Should we listen to another...>

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line: <It reminds me of the songs you used to write.>

rows.Speaker: [Yuki]
rows.Line: <I don't really see it. Besides, I wouldn't know how to arrange sounds like these.>

rows.Speaker: [Yuki]
rows.Line: <I couldn't come up with such heavy lyrics, either.>

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line: <It's true, the lyrics are completely different than what you normally write, but still...>

rows.Speaker: [Yuki]
rows.Line: <Hehe. You doubting me like this actually makes me more confident in my own work.>

rows.Speaker: [Yuki]
rows.Line: <It's hard to believe I'd be mistaken for someone so popular.>

rows.Speaker: [Yuki]
rows.Line: <Don't worry about it. I'm just surprised you remembered my old songs. It's been over a year since I wrote those.>

rows.Speaker: [Yuki]
rows.Line: <I see. It's already been quite a while since we started chatting like this, hasn't it?>

rows.Speaker: [Yuki]
rows.Line: <I was really surprised to get a DM asking to make songs together from an account with zero followers and no profile picture.>

rows.Speaker: [Yuki]
rows.Line: <I thought it was spam at first.>

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line: <After listening to your music, I knew I had to contact you right away, so I created an account on the spot.>

rows.Speaker: [Yuki]
rows.Line: <Time sure has flown, though. First Enanan joined, then Amia, and before long we even came up with a name.>

rows.Speaker: [Yuki]
rows.Line: <I never imagined I'd be making songs with other people like this a year ago.>

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line: <Hey, Yuki? Why did you agree to work with me?>

rows.Speaker: [Yuki]
rows.Line:
<I guess because it sounded fun?
It's not every day you get the chance to make songs with a group.>

rows.Speaker: [Yuki]
rows.Line: <That and because I was really impressed the first time I listened to your songs. At the time, I...>

rows.Speaker: [Yuki]
rows.Line: <I felt like your song saved me.>

rows.Speaker: [Yuki]
rows.Line: <Huh? S-Sorry, that sounded strange, didn't it? Maybe we should get back to work. It'll be morning soon.>

rows.Speaker: [Yuki]
rows.Line: <Alright, I'll talk to you later, then.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I actually managed to save someone with my songs.

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line: <Whenever I listen to OWN's music, I feel like I'm being sucked into some other place.>

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line: <There's something wrong with whoever made these. I wonder who it is.>

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line: <Listening to these makes me want to disappear, but I just can't seem to stop. So strange.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Even after making all these, I still can't find what I'm looking for.
